The '''Alchenaut sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]<ref name="Western Reaches" /> of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It included the [[Alchenaut system/Legends|Alchenaut system]].<ref name="EAOC" />
